notes.title: Fix bug of Chapter 3
notes.content:
Revised version: v1.0.4

Issue:
If Sister's event completed before Ferdinand's event started in Chapter3,
Ferdinand's event can be completed before started.

Then other events of chapter3 will not be unable to start.

Fixes:
- Fix above bug
- Added a patch to fix state if already completed Ferdinand's event without start

I apologize for the inconvenience.
